perfume.answer: South African Airways allows alcohol-based hand sanitiser in cabin and checked baggage in reasonable quantities, within 0.5 kg/L per article and 2 kg/L in total, and duty-free perfume in reasonable quantities. On international flights cabin liquids are limited to 100 ml containers in one transparent bag.

faq: Can I take perfume on South African Airways?
Duty-free perfume is permitted in reasonable quantities. In the cabin on international flights, perfume in containers over 100 ml is not accepted, even partly filled.
How much hand sanitiser can I take on South African Airways?
Reasonable quantities for own use, in cabin or checked baggage, within 0.5 kg or 0.5 L per article and 2 kg or 2 L in total.
